scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('server')) { process.chdir('server'); } require('child_process').execSync('npm install && npx prisma generate', {stdio:'inherit'});"
scripts.start: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('server/src/server.js')) { require('./server/src/server.js'); } else { require('./src/server.js'); }"
